goal: Carry forward completed M0; resolve consumer scope and CR-off status; turn saved moments into a finite-age heating approximation/error decision; adopt the supplied RUX DAG as a bass_cr overlay.
mode: bounded continuation and controlled fixed-kernel validation
in_scope: Read exact current consumer source and existing CR records without rerunning old science
Derive a positive finite-age mean-delay approximation and its C2 curvature bound
Evaluate new closure/error comparisons from saved exact p,R,S,mu records
Make a bass_cr successor DAG with early process relevance and conditional release gates
Prepare a minimal receiver interface repair only if actual code requires it
Publish additive bass_cr branch, draft PR and create-only milestone backups under existing user authorization
out_of_scope: New generator G, solve, pulse, expm, resolvent, full cascade, F retry, H dispatch
Rerun of completed M0, quadratic cone certification or old numerical suites
Mutation of rei_bianchi or other project repositories
Physical EoR history, new bath/spectrum admission, sky or production promotion
Assume a missing CR source equals zero or a unique reconstructed kernel

definitions.H0: eventual heat yield in the original source normalization; H0*qstar has heating-rate units
definitions.qstar: strictly positive declared history amplitude, including shutoff cases
definitions.dimensionless_error: absolute heating difference / (H0*qstar), not relative error of the actual heating

assumptions: Fixed nonnegative causal linear kernel and positive finite H0
Fixed bath and source spectral shape, zero prehistory and no independent initial nonthermal stock
Only the stored finite age T is evaluated; no age interpolation or density rescaling
A C2 bound needs C2 history on the closed interval and its actual curvature bound
q(0) is retained even when zero prehistory holds for t<0
acceptance: Direct derivation, dimensions, positivity and degenerate limits recorded
Exact rational new arithmetic; no prior evaluator import
One independent reference and independent scoped decision on new mathematics/code/evidence
Actual consumer facts separated from requirements and unbound fields
Executable DAG has no missing local references or cycles; optional physics not on baseline prerequisites
Source identity, actual command/exit/time, failure and mutation receipts retained

execution_budget.changed_code_targeted_checks: bounded by concrete invariant/failure risks; preserve all attempts

claim_ceiling: Recorded-model finite-age response and conditional closure sufficiency only. Numerical input error, physical source/bath error, mesh error, production and EoR claims remain separate.
